source: Ed4 J.4.1.1 and J.4.1.2, pp.J-5 to J-8; C.4.15, pp.C-55 to C-56; Ed4 L, Table L-1, p.L-18
description: A WTRP D_PDU addressed to this node draws WARNING reason 4 and a WTRP report to the bound client; a later transmission from that node with no WTRP D_PDU is reported as P2P or CSMA mode.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000, from 0.0.1.3, EOW 0, EOT 10 (end 7000): an EXTENSION (type 13, extended type 1, INVITE, a WTRP type of Annex L Table L-1, no extended header bytes) to 0.0.1.2, address size 4. No extended type is implemented, so it draws a WARNING to its sender: RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 13, reason 4 (J-0039, J-0052; J-0053 and C-0735 coordinator ruling: individual address only). At the burst end 3000 the channel analysis reports WTRP in use by 0.0.1.3, finding 1, addressee 0 (J-0051, J-0083), ahead of the MAC outputs (the DTS acts before the MAC, core-architecture.md 3.5). Report: S_MANAGEMENT_MSG_INDICATION (type 19) to every bound client, MSG TYPE 1, 9-byte MSG BODY: finding code, the node (4 bytes), the addressee of the WARNING behind it or 0 (4 bytes), addresses 28-bit most significant first (J-0082). csma.vdcd_end 4000 ms; at 7000 the last transmission was addressed only to this node, so LBT rule 1 gives a zero wait (K-0067, K-0068) and CONT_WAIT starts at once, slot 15, 45000 ms; at 52000 the WARNING goes out: type 15, address size 3, 0.0.1.2 to 0.0.1.3, EOW 0, EOT 10 (one block, duration 5550). At 70000 another burst from 0.0.1.3: a PADDING to 0.0.1.2, EOT 1, no WTRP type and no token EOW, so 0.0.1.3 is now taken to be in P2P or CSMA mode (J-0046), reported at its end as finding 2 because WTRP was the last mode reported for it. Nothing is queued, so the MAC is silent.
